review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Overview: Design, develop, maintain, and enhance the firm's internal business applications and reporting solutions, ensuring accurate, timely, and reliable information to support daily operations and business decision-making and act as bridge between business requirements and technical solutions by translating user needs into applications, database logic, and reports. Gather and analyze business requirements from non-technical users to translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and practical solutions. Develop and maintain SAP Crystal Reports including formulas, grouping, suppression logic, and integration with .NET applications to support operational and client-facing reporting requirements. Collaborate with Business, Operations, IT Infrastructure, and other stakeholders to deliver technology solutions aligned with business requirements and reporting deadlines.
